mentions.name: Word-reveal epub reader
mentions.description: This epub reader displays a book one word at a time, requiring a button press to reveal the next word. It improves reading comprehension, prevents inadvertent skimming, and keeps the mind from wandering while reading.
mentions.problem: Typing out an entire book to stay focused is too tedious, and normal reading lets the mind wander and invites skimming.
mentions.audience: People with ADHD or borderline ADHD who struggle to stay focused while reading.
mentions.source_excerpt: My current epub reader software I use requires you to press a button to reveal the next word. This has dramatically improved my reading comprehension, prevents inadvertent skimming, and keeps my mind from wandering.

evidence.value: My current epub reader software I use requires you to press a button to reveal the next word. This has dramatically improved my reading comprehension, prevents inadvertent skimming, and keeps my mind from wandering.
